## Activity

During June 2021, North City Eye Clinic recorded 292 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading performance for the month. The recorded volume should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting, with any operational issues noted alongside capture activity.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 4 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.4. The result should be reviewed as part of routine quality assurance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be followed up and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 60 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. This measure should be maintained through regular monitoring, with particular attention to any variation in turnaround. The activity, image quality and grading measures together provide the monthly operational position for North City Eye Clinic.
